title: Trust beyond accuracy: an evidence-based validation study of a NACA surrogate
description: OpenFOAM campaign on a NACA four-digit family -- a mesh family with a grid-convergence study and a design of experiments split by design -- a POD+MLP ensemble surrogate, accuracy and physical-consistency validation, an evidence domain that answers where a prediction is supported, camber opened as a new parameter dimension with its own campaign, and the dossier that records all of it.

checks.name: mesh_convergence_CL
checks.detail: change in CL between the two finest of 4 meshes; the family oscillates at this level, so no grid-convergence index is claimed

checks.name: gate_continuity_residual
checks.detail: the prediction's continuity residual is 1.025 against the reference's own 1.015 -- both normalised by the size of their own gradients

checks.name: boundary_condition_no_slip
checks.detail: the declared Dirichlet condition at the wall: the prediction departs from it by 0.0257 of the freestream, the reference itself by 0.0261 -- a ratio of 0.99, because a wall-function solution has no sample at the wall

checks.name: freestream_decay
checks.detail: the outermost ring departs from the freestream by 0.084 of U_inf, against the reference's 0.079 -- the ring is at a quarter chord from the surface, so neither reaches zero

checks.name: pressure_integral_consistency
checks.detail: lift from integrating the predicted wall pressure differs from the predicted CL by 0.319; the same integral on the reference differs from the reference's CL by 0.314

checks.name: accuracy_CL
checks.detail: relative L2 on 16 designs held out by design

checks.name: field_accuracy
checks.detail: relative L2 over u, v and cp on the lattice, mean over the held-out designs: 14.8%. The 8-mode basis alone reconstructs the same fields to 4.6%, so the bar is twice the floor the model's own representation imposes -- a scalar can be right while the field it integrates is not

checks.name: uncertainty_calibration_coverage
checks.detail: the raw ensemble spread covers 43% of held-out errors at one sigma (narrower than nominal: the bar under-covers)

checks.name: robustness_input_sensitivity
checks.detail: movement of CL under a 1 % nudge of each input, over the ensemble spread, worst input: alpha_deg 0.72, speed 0.05, thickness 0.05

checks.name: declared_checks_all_ran
checks.detail: checks declared but not run: reproducibility_rerun

checks.name: dossier_status
checks.detail: VC-52ddc41c9f: failed (mandatory criterion not met: VP-001 (A mandatory check failed); VP-002 (A mandatory check failed); VP-003 (A mandatory check failed); VP-004 (Error above the declared tolerance); VP-005 (Error above the declared tolerance); VP-006 (Error above the declared tolerance); VP-007 (Error above the declared tolerance))

references: Celik, I.B., Ghia, U., Roache, P.J. (2008). Procedure for estimation and reporting of uncertainty due to discretization in CFD applications. J. Fluids Eng. 130, 078001.
